This topic is part of the Cambridge IGCSE GCSE Religious Studies specification.

Islam: The Life & Importance of the Prophet Muhammad appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

The Cambridge IGCSE board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.
